code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Midum Silk Waves</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#030305}
canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  var canvas = document.getElementById("c");
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  var w = 0, h = 0, dpr = 1, grad = null, vig = null, glow = null;
  var N = 44, STEP = 56, INTENSITY = 0.8;
  var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

  function resize(){
    dpr = 1;
    w = window.innerWidth; h = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.round(w * dpr); canvas.height = Math.round(h * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, w, 0);
    grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)");
    grad.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(255,255,255,1)");
    grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)");
    vig = ctx.createRadialGradient(w / 2, h / 2, Math.min(w, h) * 0.2, w / 2, h / 2, Math.max(w, h) * 0.75);
    vig.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    vig.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)");
    glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, h * 0.84, 0, 0, h * 0.84, w * 0.36);
    glow.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,0.10)");
    glow.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
  }

  function draw(t){
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#030305";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    var A1 = h * 0.07, A2 = h * 0.11, slope = -0.17;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
    for (var i = 0; i < N; i++){
      var y0 = (i / (N - 1)) * (h * 1.6) - h * 0.25;
      ctx.globalAlpha = (0.03 + 0.055 * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(i * 0.31 + t * 0.4))) * INTENSITY * 1.6;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (var x = -STEP; x <= w + STEP; x += STEP){
        var y = y0 + slope * (x - w / 2)
              + A1 * Math.sin(x * 0.0042 + t * 0.35 + i * 0.045)
              + A2 * Math.sin(x * 0.0021 - t * 0.22 + i * 0.03 + 1.7);
        if (x === -STEP) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.fillStyle = vig;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
  }

  window.addEventListener("resize", function(){ resize(); if (reduce) draw(4); });
  resize();
  if (reduce){ draw(4); return; }

  var last = 0, t0 = performance.now();
  function frame(now){
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    if (now - last < 42) return;   // ~24fps keeps it cheap behind the whole UI
    last = now;
    draw((now - t0) / 1000);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
